name: Hawk Shield
description: Raise a plate of qi at the forearm in the shape of a folded wing to meet a blow.

name: Descending Press
description: Press the plate down onto an opponent's raised weapon arm to drive it low.

name: Twinned Pace
description: Step beside a partner in matched time so the two plates stay edge to edge.

name: Talon Bind
description: Close two taloned wards round an attacker's weapon arm and hold it fast against the plate.

name: Pair Cleanse
description: Pass cleansing qi between the paired plates and through an ally to wash out poison and taint.

name: Feather Cushion
description: Cushion a heavy hit in layers of feathered qi that spread its force over the whole plate.

name: Hawkwing Veil
description: Hold a wide veil of qi like a spread wing against strikes from the front and from above.

name: Hawkdrop Strike
description: Drop with the plate leading from above and strike through the opponent's guard.

name: Highwing Mantle
description: Spread a high mantle over a partner and the user that firms both guards for as long as the two stand together.

name: Hawkfall Aegis
description: The school's closing move: two plates fall together like hawks and shield the pair while they strike as one.

name: Verdict Plate
description: Raise a plate of qi held level and still as a scale before the blow that must be weighed.

name: Measured Press
description: Press the plate forward by exactly the reach of the opponent's strike and no more.

name: Weighing Palm
description: Rest the plate lightly on a blow and weigh its force to tell how much ward it needs.

name: Stern Rebuke
description: Return a blow to the striker with exactly the force it carried and not a grain more.

name: Binding Judgement
description: Bind an attacker's weapon arm under the plate until the attacker yields the blow.

name: Clean Verdict
description: Rule poison and taint out of an ally's body with a clear steady flow of qi.

name: Fair Mending
description: Mend each of an ally's wounds in turn under the plate by the weight of its hurt.

name: Impartial Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that bears every blow alike and neither tires nor takes sides.

name: Gavel Wave
description: Bring the plate down like a gavel and send a hard wave across the ground that throws back every attacker.

name: Stern Absolute
description: Rule against a mighty blow and cancel it entirely in the stillness of the plate.

name: Judgement Plate
description: The school's closing move: the plate gives judgement on a blow and its force is struck from the attacker.

name: Near Plate
description: Raise the plate nearest the opponent and hold the second behind it.

name: Far Plate
description: Hold the far plate wide of the body so a blow that clears the first meets the second.

name: Plate Slide
description: Slide the near plate along the face of the far one and carry a blow out to the side.

name: Plate Hum
description: Listen to the two plates hum against each other for the first tremor of a coming blow.

name: Plate Clasp
description: Clasp the two plates round an attacker's weapon and hold it still between them.

name: Plate Echo
description: Let a blow ring from plate to plate and send it back doubled to the attacker.

name: Plate Lending
description: Lend the second plate to an ally whose own guard is wearing thin.

name: Plate Salve
description: Lay the warmed second plate against an ally's wound and let its qi seep in and close it.

name: Plate Crown
description: Raise both plates over the head as a crown and hold them against a press from above.

name: Plate Thunder
description: Clap the plates together to send a thunderous shock round the user that staggers all near.

name: Plate Absolute
description: Seat both plates in one so dense that a mighty blow dies in it without a tremor.

name: Twin Sundering
description: The school's closing move: both plates fall on the worn guard together and sunder it.

name: Skyward Plate
description: Lift a broad plate of pale qi against a blow from above.

name: Pale Gliding
description: Drift sideways along the qi field and keep the ward closed in the new place.

name: Azure Hum
description: Feel a faint azure hum in the field at the approach of a blow from any side.

name: Azure Riposte
description: Return an attack across the field as a clear beam of azure qi.

name: Wide Mantle
description: Spread a wide mantle across the field and let it follow each ally within it.

name: Azure Tethering
description: Bind an opponent in a net of pale qi that grows tighter with each struggle.

name: Wide Aegis
description: Hold an aegis spanning the whole qi field and keep it steady against several blows.

name: Azure Burst
description: Burst the outer edge of the field outward and throw back everything pressed against it.

name: Pale Absolute
description: Wipe a mighty blow out of existence at the edge of the field with a single pale sweep.

name: Wing Ascendant
description: The school's closing move: a wing of ward rises over every ally and lifts their guards with it.

name: Core Plate
description: Press a plate of qi out of the Core to the front of the body.

name: Core Pace
description: Step forward with the Core's weight so the ward moves with the body and never gaps.

name: Core Gauging
description: Read the force of an attack from the way it shakes the ward at its root in the Core.

name: Core Rebuke
description: Return a blow from the Core in one dense pulse that follows the strike back to its source.

name: Core Gathering
description: Gather the force of a blow into the Core like water into a basin and store it.

name: Core Lending
description: Lend a thread of the Core's ward to an ally and keep it fed.

name: Core Cleansing
description: Draw poison and taint and the lingering bite of a curse out of an ally through the Core's ward.

name: Corebound Aegis
description: Hold an aegis rooted in the Core that does not tire while the Core stays whole.

name: Repel Ring
description: Release stored Core qi in a ring that flings every attacker off the user's ground.

name: Core Stillness
description: Drop the Core into perfect stillness so that a mighty blow finds nothing to strike and is cancelled.

name: Core Aegis Absolute
description: The school's closing move: the whole Core opens into an aegis that stands against any single force below its own grade.

name: Vow Plate
description: Speak the vow and raise a plate of qi bound to the word.

name: Gale Pressing
description: Press the plate forward on a hard gust and shove an attacker out of reach of the sworn.

name: Oathward Stride
description: Step toward a sworn ally at the first cry and put the plate between the ally and harm.

name: Vow Attending
description: Hear through the vow when a sworn ally is struck and name the side the blow fell.

name: Vow Rebuke
description: Throw a blow aimed at the sworn back at the striker with the vow's weight behind it.

name: Oath Tending
description: Mend a sworn ally's wounds with qi that runs easily along the oath.

name: Vow Tethering
description: Bind an attacker to the vow so the attacker cannot strike the sworn while it stands.

name: Wind Cleansing
description: Send a clean wind through a sworn ally to carry out poison and taint.

name: Oathen Canopy
description: Spread a canopy of oath-bound qi over a sworn company and hold it against heavy blows.

name: Oathen Gusting
description: Loose a hard gust from the canopy and scatter every attacker round the sworn.

name: Oath Absolute
description: Hold the vow with the whole will and let it cancel one mighty blow against the sworn.

name: Oathkeeper Plate
description: The school's closing move: the plate that only the oathkeeper lifts and which firms every guard the oath covers.

name: Windsworn Plate
description: Set a plate of wind-bound qi to the front and let blows glance from it.

name: Drift Shove
description: Shove an opponent aside on a drift of wind from the plate's edge.

name: Sworn Feeling
description: Feel through the wind which of the sworn is nearest to a coming strike.

name: Warding Mantle
description: Cast a mantle over a sworn ally that holds as firm as the ally keeps the oath.

name: Gust Turning
description: Turn a strike with a hard turning gust and send it past the sworn.

name: Hush Binding
description: Hush the wind about an opponent and drain the opponent's force for a few breaths.

name: Windsworn Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that bends with the wind and does not break under any push.

name: Sworn Bursting
description: Burst the aegis outward in a gale that scatters the attackers about the sworn.

name: Gale Absolute
description: Take a mighty blow into the gale and spend it to nothing in the open air.

name: Windsworn Rebuke
description: The school's closing move: the shield turns every blow aside with the gale and returns it with the oath.

name: Posted Plate
description: Post a plate of qi on the line of the attack and hold the stance behind it.

name: Bearing Drive
description: Thrust the plate forward along the bearing and knock an attacker off the line.

name: Bearing Carry
description: Shift to the next post of the bearing without letting the ward fall behind.

name: Steadying Lend
description: Lend an ally the steadiness of the bearing through a hand laid on the ally's shoulder.

name: Bearing Clearing
description: Hold an ally steady while clean qi washes poison and taint from the blood.

name: Bearing Binding
description: Bind an attacker to the bearing so that every step the attacker takes brings the attacker back to it.

name: Bearing Rebuke
description: Return the weight of a blow along the bearing straight back to the striker.

name: Fixed Aegis
description: Hold an aegis fixed to the bearing that does not shift under any press.

name: Bearing Wave
description: Send the stored weight of the bearing out in a long wave that shoves back all in front.

name: Bearing Entire
description: Take a mighty blow upon the bearing and sink it into the ground without a pace given.

name: Bearing Eternal
description: The school's closing move: the bearing sets like stone and seals the line against any who would cross it.

name: Open Plate
description: Raise a plate with no hard rim and let it flex before the blow.

name: Wind Press
description: Press an opponent back with the pushing air of the open plate.

name: Loose Pace
description: Move with a loose light stride and carry the open ward with every step.

name: Draught Reading
description: Read a draught across the ward and know the direction of a thrown or loosed blow.

name: Open Rebuke
description: Return a blow on the open ward as a gust that bowls the striker over.

name: Open Lending
description: Lend a share of the open ward to an ally and let it flex with the ally's movement.

name: Draught Cleansing
description: Draw a clean draught through an ally's body to carry off poison and taint.

name: Wind Mending
description: Breathe a soft mending wind over an ally's wounds until they close.

name: Rimless Aegis
description: Hold an aegis with no rim that gives where it is pressed and thickens where it is not.

name: Unrimmed Burst
description: Open the aegis outward in a burst of wind that clears the ground about the sworn.

name: Open Absolute
description: Open the whole aegis to a mighty blow and let it pass out into nothing.

name: Open Gale Aegis
description: The school's closing move: the aegis opens like a gale over the sworn and answers every blow.

name: Vowed Plate
description: Raise a plate of qi drawn from the Core and bound to a spoken vow.

name: Warding Stride
description: Take a long stride to a sworn ally and carry the ward across the gap.

name: Vowed Feel
description: Feel through the vow which sworn ally is nearest to harm.

name: Vowed Return
description: Return a blow against the sworn to the striker as a pulse of Core qi.

name: Vowed Gift
description: Give a sworn ally part of the Core's ward and keep it flowing.

name: Vowed Purge
description: Purge a curse or taint from a sworn ally through the vow and the Core's ward.

name: Vowed Tending
description: Tend a sworn ally's wounds with Core qi until the flesh knits.

name: Vowed Canopy
description: Spread a canopy of Core qi over the sworn and hold it through a long fight.

name: Warding Surge
description: Release the vow's stored force in a surge that throws back every attacker.

name: Vowed Absolute
description: Hold an unbroken ward from the Core that nothing below the user's grade can pierce.

name: Boundless Sworn Ward
description: The school's closing move: the ward leaves the Core and spreads over the sworn with no wall and no bound but the oath.
